components.html:
✨ Description:

Selena sings a haunting aria that channels the protective spirit of her owl-shaped belt buckle. Allies within range gain temporary hit points equal to 2d8 + Selena’s Charisma modifier and advantage on saving throws against fear and charm effects. This spell functions as Greater Heroism, but with a thematic twist: if an ally falls to 0 HP during the duration, they instead drop to 1 HP and are surrounded by spectral owl wings until the spell ends.

Owlheart rise, in moonlight bound,
Lift my friends from battleground.
Feathered shield and fearless soul,
Sing with me and make us whole.

* - (owl feather dipped in moonwater)
